title: Room Tone: McFarlin Auditorium by lakewoodsound
author: lakewoodsound
sourceDescription: Room tone (ambience) of an empty McFarlin Auditorium on the campus of Southern Methodist University (SMU) in Dallas, TX, USA. McFarlin Memorial Auditorium opened in 1926. It seats 2,386 on 3 levels, and is still used for many events and performances for both the university and local organizations.
modifications: cut 9.97-24.97s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +24.00 dB (peak -37.20 dBFS); 30 ms fades
